subject: Proposal: provisional rate freeze + staged credits for renewal
messages:
From: Elliot Stone <elliot.stone@fathom.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion + capacity increase

Hi Grace,

We’re coming up on our annual renewal (account: Fathom AI). Over the last 6 months our usage for inference has grown ~38% month-over-month due to a new feature launch. We want to expand committed capacity by ~40% and lock a predictable unit cost while we stabilize forecasts.

Key asks from our side: 
- A 12-month rate freeze (keep current unit price) while we scale.
- A committed discount on the new committed volume (we’re thinking something in the 8–12% range).
- A one-time credit to offset migration and engineering onboarding costs (roughly $15k–$25k).
- A billing timing preference: can we push the Q3 invoice 30 days to align with our revenue cadence?

We value Redwood’s runtime performance but need predictable economics. Can you propose an approach? Also loop in anyone on your side who needs to approve credits/term changes.

Thanks,
Elliot Stone
Head of ML Ops, Fathom AI
elliot.stone@fathom.ai
+1 415-555-0127

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Stone <elliot.stone@fathom.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + capacity increase

Hi Elliot — thanks for the clear asks and context. We can get you predictable economics while supporting the scale-up. High-level proposal below; attached is a provisional term sheet for legal/finance review.

Summary proposal (provisional)
- Term: 12 months starting at renewal date; Redwood agrees to a 12-month rate freeze on current per-token/list-price for the existing + incremental committed volume.
- Commit: Increase committed throughput by 40% (new baseline). Committed discount on the incremental volume: 10% off list unit price.
- One-time credit: $20,000 engineering/onboarding credit applied to the first invoice after contract execution.
- Invoice timing: We can shift the Q3 invoice by 30 days as a one-time accommodation (subject to credit approval).
- Protection: Add an overage cap that limits monthly overage charges to 30% above committed spend for the first 3 months post-renewal; after that standard overage rates apply.

Next steps
1) If this looks reasonable, we’ll send an updated term sheet and DocuSign.
2) I’ve looped in Marissa and Ben to confirm credit and invoice accommodation.
3) If Finance asks for contractual guardrails, we’ll propose a minimum usage floor (1.05x current committed baseline) for the 12-month term.

Attachment: fathom_provisional-term-sheet-20270530.pdf

Let me know if you want to trade any elements (e.g., longer term in exchange for larger credit).

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Director, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 650-555-9790

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: FWD: Renewal discussion + capacity increase — credit & deferral approval needed

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Elliot's ask and the provisional terms. Key decision points for finance/legal: 
- Approve one-time $20k credit against first invoice (deal FTH-2027-084).
- Approve a single 30-day invoice deferral for Q3.
- Confirm margin impact with the 10% committed discount on incremental volume and 12-month rate freeze.

Quoted for context: 
> On 2027-05-30T08:05:00-07:00, Elliot Stone wrote:
> We’re coming up on our annual renewal... key asks: rate freeze, committed discount, one-time credit, billing timing

Can you confirm whether finance needs additional guardrails (e.g., minimum term extension or usage floor) to approve?

Thanks — grace

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-31T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FWD: Renewal discussion + capacity increase — credit & deferral approval needed

Grace / Ben,

I’m OK approving the $20k one-time credit and the 30-day deferral on the following conditions: 
- Add a contractual usage floor equal to 1.05x current committed baseline for the 12-month term (protects revenue if usage drops).
- Include a 90-day review clause: if usage is >2.0x baseline within 90 days, we’ll renegotiate excess pricing (protects capacity planning).
- Ensure the overage cap (30% for first 3 months) is in the term sheet.

If legal is happy with those guardrails I approve. Ben — please confirm accounting runway for the deferred invoice and that we’ll net the $20k credit off the first invoice rather than treating as a separate credit memo.

Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-31T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FWD: Renewal discussion + capacity increase — credit & deferral approval needed

Marissa / Grace — we have runway to absorb a $20k one-time credit and to shift a single invoice by 30 days. Accounting notes: we’ll net the credit against the first invoice and document the deferral in the billing notes. Please confirm final signed term to generate PO/invoice schedule.

Ben Carter
Sr. Manager, Commercial Finance
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Stone <elliot.stone@fathom.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, billing@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-01T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Updated terms & DocuSign (FTH-2027-084)

Hi Elliot — thanks for the patience. We have internal approvals with the following guardrails (as discussed):
- $20,000 one-time onboarding credit netted against the first invoice.
- Single 30-day deferral for the Q3 invoice accommodated.
- Usage floor: 1.05x current committed baseline for the 12-month term.
- Overage cap: 30% cap on monthly overage charges for months 1–3 post-renewal.
- Review clause at 90 days for unusually large upticks.

I’ve attached the updated term sheet and shared a DocuSign link to finalize. Please review and sign by EOD 2027-06-07 to lock the provisional rate freeze and the credit.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/1234/FTH-2027-084 (attached link in docusign-FTH-2027-084-link.txt)
Attachment: fathom_provisional-term-sheet-20270530.pdf

If you want to trade a longer-term (18 months) for a larger onboarding credit, we can outline that alternative.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Director, Redwood Inference

From: Elliot Stone <elliot.stone@fathom.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: billing@fathom.ai

Grace — this looks good, appreciate the flexibility. I signed the DocuSign this morning and looped in our billing team for PO processing. Our billing contact is finance-ops@fathom.ai. We’ll aim to return the signed PO by 2027-06-07.

One operational ask: please call out in the invoice notes that the $20k credit should be applied to the first invoice and that we agreed to a one-time 30-day deferral for the Q3 invoice.

Elliot
